scope.summary: cargo_patch_warning_guard.sh runs cargo metadata with CARGO_TERM_COLOR=never so the anchored '^warning: patch .+ was not used in the crate graph$' check sees Cargo's plain diagnostic even when CI exports CARGO_TERM_COLOR=always; the release contract test first proves Cargo emits ANSI under forced color, then proves the guard still refuses.
out_of_scope: Other release-rehearsal jobs that were skipped after the failing step.

entry_points.name: scripts/release_preflight.sh -> scripts/cargo_patch_warning_guard.sh (release gate 'Validate release metadata')
entry_points.trace: CARGO_TERM_COLOR=always bash tests/release_contract_test.sh -> 'release-contract-test: OK'. Out-of-tree differential on an unused-patch fixture: pre-fix guard (3ada7e35^) with CARGO_TERM_COLOR=always exits 0 and does not refuse (fail-open), with =never exits 1 and refuses; fixed guard exits 1 and refuses under both. The anchored regex is byte-identical to the pre-fix guard.

limitations: The hosted release rehearsal named in the bead (workflow_dispatch of release.yml) was not re-run; it is an operator-gated action. The failing step was reproduced locally with release.yml's CARGO_TERM_COLOR=always.
